title: Privileged Identity Management automation
summary: Deploys and validates Microsoft Entra PIM role policies, authentication contexts, and optional administrator notifications with fail-closed ownership controls.
highlights: Guides administrators through role-tier configuration with plan-first validation.
Uses exact tenant-bound ownership and crash-resumable mutation checkpoints.
Supports optional polling notifications without retaining delegated tokens or client secrets.
Provides repository-contained validation for component provenance and deployment readiness.
